text_block_list.text:
Hearing Matikanetannhauser's voice, I
head to
the training track...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
How was my run just now? My
uniqueness shined
through, right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Appearance: bizarre. Chances of being
reported
for suspicious activity: high.
Conclusion: subject's
running form
exceeds reasonable parameters of

"uniqueness."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, you know... You might end up
falling over if
you keep wriggling around
when you run...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello! So, um, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to try running in a unique way
so I can
get a bunch of fans!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I was just asking these
two for
some advice!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I think that... just running normally is
probably
better...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. I detect no correlation
between
"uniqueness" and successful
race performance.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-well, just keep watching. I'm sure my next attempt will really be the one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Crabby-crabby!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So? How'd you like my sideways
running?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing situation. Implementation in
race will
result in immediate
disqualification.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what if I close my eyes? I'll just try...
running
like this and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nope! No, no, no! Too scary!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-and dangerous too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Okay, how about I try... running while
reading a
book?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Running or walking while distracted is
also
prohibited at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... W-wait...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's just no way this is gonna work, is
there?!
How am I supposed to win with
such ridiculous
running styles?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Racing is insanely tough! Everyone's trying so hard to be the best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Judging from your faces... you all figured
that out
already. You unique
Umamusume really are on a
different
level. Urghhh...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. Uniqueness has no bearing on
the
realization in question.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not sure if Tannhauser is listening
to what
we're saying...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um... as a professional trainer, can you
think of
any other running styles that
might leave an
impression on people?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: If you can, please share!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh...
choice_data_list: All we have to do is win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Coming in first place leaves
a lasting
impression, resulting in high
memorability.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see. Now that you mention it, that does
make
sense, doesn't it? Everyone
remembers the
winner...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And that means they'll support me... And
I might
even make them happy?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Checking schedule and current training
regimen...
Availability confirmed.
Perhaps I could do some
partner running
with you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm available too, but um... I just hope
nothing
bad happens.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course it won't! Aw, thanks so much,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You guys are right... If I focus too hard
on being
unique, I won't be able to run
properly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna focus on winning! I'll take first like BLAM! Let's do some partner running together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... They're so fast! Wow...
Seriously...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I better work extra hard! I'm
gonna give it
my all and make it to their
level...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'm gonna win! I know I can do it!

More determined than ever,
Matikanetannhauser
and her friends
keep running right up until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yep... If you come first, you'll leave an
impression
without having to do any
weird runs.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-weird?! Weird... I guess you're right.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. My calculations also suggest
that
your crab walk will only induce
disdain in the
audience.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Okay, okay. Maybe I went a little
too far...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, my analysis indicates that your tenacity is your charm, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I agree. I think that charm catches
people's
attention.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was stopping to stare at you
just now,
Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really?!

I look around to see multiple
Umamusume staring
at
Matikanetannhauser with curious
expressions.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, this isn't what I wanted! Aaagh! This
is the
wrong kind of attention!

Matikanetannhauser slumps down on the
spot,
exasperated and extremely
embarrassed.
